name: nothing_to_do_with_saturated_window_holds
why: THE LIVELOCK. A worker correctly acks nothing_to_do on an out-of-scope item while the checker reports complete:false. The ack is honest and the hold is correct, but the combination stalls: the watermark never moves, the same item re-fires every tick, and after YAAS_UNACKED_PROMOTE (3) no-progress dispatches the watch is parked as misconfig. Left alone it repeats indefinitely on a live watch. incomplete_window_holds covers the handled+incomplete pair; this covers nothing_to_do+incomplete, which is the pair that actually bites.
